preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**4 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after t is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^4) representing the number of elements in the array.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**5 for x in a) for n, a in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains n positive integers a_1, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^5) representing the array elements.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '-1' or (stdout_line.strip() != '-1' and (k := int(stdout_line.strip()) if stdout_line.strip() != '-1' else 0) >= 0 and k <= 3 * n) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (no solution) or a non-negative integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ 3n) representing the number of operations, followed by k lines of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '-1' or (stdout_line.strip() != '-1' and (k := int(stdout_line.strip()) if stdout_line.strip() != '-1' else 0) >= 0 and k <= 3 * n and all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and x >= 0 for i, j, x in [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:k+1]])) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: If k > 0, each operation line contains three integers i, j, x (1 ≤ i, j ≤ n; 0 ≤ x ≤ 10^9) representing the operation parameters.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '-1' or (stdout_line.strip() != '-1' and (k := int(stdout_line.strip()) if stdout_line.strip() != '-1' else 0) >= 0 and k <= 3 * n and all(all(a[i] >= 0 for i in range(1, n+1)) for a in [list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[2::2][test_case])) for test_case in range(t)]) and all(all(a[i] == a[j] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1)) for a in [list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[2::2][test_case])) for test_case in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: If k > 0, after applying the operations, all elements of the array must be equal and non-negative.
